description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility located in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader to drive excellence in patient care, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.
The ideal candidate will possess a strong commitment to quality and a proven track record in managing long-term care facilities. This full-time role offers a competitive salary, providing an excellent opportunity for an accomplished LNHA to make a significant impact within a supportive environment. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and fostering a positive community for residents and staff.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Demonstrated leadership and operational management expertise
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal long-term care regulations
Strong financial acumen and ability to manage facility budgets
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
Join a leading home health agency in Orlando, FL, dedicated to providing exceptional patient care in the comfort of their homes. This flexible Full-time/Part-time role offers a competitive compensation of $65 per visit, allowing you to manage your schedule while making a significant impact on patient well-being. We are seeking compassionate and skilled clinicians to deliver high-quality care across the Orlando area.

This is an urgent opening, and we are actively scheduling interviews. We offer flexible interview slots Monday through Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, with additional availability over the weekend as needed, to accommodate your schedule. If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity with autonomy and excellent per-visit pay, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Florida RN or LPN license
Prior experience in home health or a similar community-based setting
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Excellent clinical assessment and documentation skills
